import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color palette: editorial, stark ---
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia': '#DD8452',
    'Europe': '#4C72B0',
    'North America': '#55A868',
}
REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAF7'
GRID_COLOR = '#DDDDD8'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2B2B2B'
SUBTLE_TEXT = '#6B6B6B'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'figure.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': SUBTLE_TEXT,
    'ytick.color': SUBTLE_TEXT,
    'axes.edgecolor': GRID_COLOR,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('The Global Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Inequality Across Four Dimensions',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, y=0.97, x=0.5, ha='center')
fig.text(0.5, 0.948, '2023 estimates  |  Penetration = share of individuals who used the internet in the past three months  |  Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research',
         fontsize=8.5, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, ha='center')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, hspace=0.34, wspace=0.26, left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.91, bottom=0.06)

# ============================================================
# Panel A: Income quintile slope chart
# ============================================================
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_a.set_title('A. Income Gradient', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
quintile_labels = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
x_inc = np.arange(len(quintile_labels))

for region in REGION_ORDER:
    vals = [d['penetration'] for d in income_data if d['region'] == region]
    ax_a.plot(x_inc, vals, marker='o', markersize=5, linewidth=2.2, color=COLORS[region],
              label=region, zorder=3)
    # Direct label at Q5
    ax_a.annotate(f'{vals[-1]}%', xy=(x_inc[-1], vals[-1]),
                  xytext=(6, 0), textcoords='offset points',
                  fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold', va='center')
    # Show Q1-Q5 spread
    spread = vals[-1] - vals[0]
    mid_y = (vals[0] + vals[-1]) / 2
    ax_a.annotate(f'Δ{spread}pp', xy=(0.3, vals[0] + spread * 0.35),
                  fontsize=7, color=COLORS[region], fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.85)

ax_a.set_xticks(x_inc)
ax_a.set_xticklabels(quintile_labels, fontsize=8)
ax_a.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=9)
ax_a.set_ylim(-2, 105)
ax_a.set_xlim(-0.3, 4.8)
ax_a.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax_a.tick_params(axis='x', length=0)
for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax_a.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

# ============================================================
# Panel B: Age group line chart
# ============================================================
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_b.set_title('B. Age Divide', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
age_labels = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']
x_age = np.arange(len(age_labels))

for region in REGION_ORDER:
    vals = [d['penetration'] for d in age_data if d['region'] == region]
    ax_b.plot(x_age, vals, marker='o', markersize=5, linewidth=2.2, color=COLORS[region],
              label=region, zorder=3)
    # Direct label at 15-24
    ax_b.annotate(f'{vals[0]}%', xy=(x_age[0], vals[0]),
                  xytext=(-18, 6), textcoords='offset points',
                  fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold', va='bottom')
    # Direct label at 65+
    ax_b.annotate(f'{vals[-1]}%', xy=(x_age[-1], vals[-1]),
                  xytext=(6, 0), textcoords='offset points',
                  fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold', va='center')

# Highlight youth-elder gap with annotation for Sub-Saharan Africa
ssa_vals = [d['penetration'] for d in age_data if d['region'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
ax_b.annotate('', xy=(5.15, ssa_vals[-1]), xytext=(5.15, ssa_vals[0]),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=COLORS['Sub-Saharan Africa'], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6))

ax_b.set_xticks(x_age)
ax_b.set_xticklabels(age_labels, fontsize=8)
ax_b.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=9)
ax_b.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=9)
ax_b.set_ylim(-2, 105)
ax_b.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax_b.tick_params(axis='x', length=0)
for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax_b.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

# ============================================================
# Panel C: Urban-Rural gap (dumbbell / dot plot)
# ============================================================
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_c.set_title('C. Urban–Rural Gap', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
y_pos = np.arange(len(REGION_ORDER))
bar_color_urban = '#4C72B0'
bar_color_rural = '#C44E52'

for i, region in enumerate(reversed(REGION_ORDER)):
    urban = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Urban')
    rural = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Rural')
    gap = urban - rural
    # Connecting line
    ax_c.plot([rural, urban], [i, i], color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=2, zorder=1)
    # Dots
    ax_c.scatter(rural, i, s=90, color=bar_color_rural, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax_c.scatter(urban, i, s=90, color=bar_color_urban, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
    # Gap label
    ax_c.annotate(f'{gap}pp gap', xy=((rural + urban) / 2, i),
                  xytext=(0, 10), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8,
                  ha='center', color=TEXT_COLOR, fontweight='bold')
    # Value labels
    ax_c.annotate(f'{rural}%', xy=(rural, i), xytext=(-8, -14),
                  textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color=bar_color_rural)
    ax_c.annotate(f'{urban}%', xy=(urban, i), xytext=(8, -14),
                  textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color=bar_color_urban)

ax_c.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_c.set_yticklabels(list(reversed(REGION_ORDER)), fontsize=9)
ax_c.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=9)
ax_c.set_xlim(-2, 105)
ax_c.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax_c.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax_c.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

# Legend for dumbbell
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=bar_color_urban, markersize=8, label='Urban'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=bar_color_rural, markersize=8, label='Rural'),
]
ax_c.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower right', frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)

# ============================================================
# Panel D: Regional overview — grouped bar with population context
# ============================================================
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_d.set_title('D. Regional Overview', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

overall = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']
regions_sorted = sorted(overall, key=lambda d: d['overall_penetration'])
region_names = [d['region'] for d in regions_sorted]
penetrations = [d['overall_penetration'] for d in regions_sorted]
populations = [d['population_millions'] for d in regions_sorted]
users = [d['internet_users_millions'] for d in regions_sorted]

y_bar = np.arange(len(region_names))
bar_height = 0.55

# Full bar = population context (light), colored portion = internet users
for i, (reg, pen, pop, usr) in enumerate(zip(region_names, penetrations, populations, users)):
    # Background bar: total population (faint)
    ax_d.barh(i, pop, height=bar_height, color=COLORS[reg], alpha=0.15, zorder=1)
    # Foreground bar: internet users
    ax_d.barh(i, usr, height=bar_height, color=COLORS[reg], alpha=0.85, zorder=2)
    # Penetration label
    ax_d.annotate(f'{pen}%', xy=(usr + 15, i), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
                  color=COLORS[reg], va='center', zorder=4)
    # Population context
    ax_d.annotate(f'{usr}M / {pop}M', xy=(pop + 15, i), fontsize=7.5,
                  color=SUBTLE_TEXT, va='center', zorder=4)

ax_d.set_yticks(y_bar)
ax_d.set_yticklabels(region_names, fontsize=9)
ax_d.set_xlabel('Population (millions)', fontsize=9)
ax_d.set_xlim(0, 2350)
ax_d.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax_d.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax_d.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

# Inline legend
ax_d.text(1600, 3.6, 'Darker bar = internet users\nFull bar = total population',
          fontsize=7.5, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, va='top')

# ============================================================
# Shared legend for panels A & B (regions)
# ============================================================
legend_handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color=COLORS[r], linewidth=2, markersize=5, label=r)
                  for r in REGION_ORDER]
fig.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper center', ncol=4, frameon=False,
           fontsize=9, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.935))

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=BG_COLOR)
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
